I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 16 August deadline either way:

- **No channel mentions:** nobody has mentioned Tamsin or that deadline in #central-team.
- **The date has passed:** if they meant 16 August this year, that was two months before the message (19 Oct). So either they meant a different date or the deadline was missed.

I suggested Pree check the date with their Tamsin contact or with deal desk before anyone plans around it. I didn't search other channels, because Pree can't see them.
